changes.evidence: In What If...? episode 9 (S1), after Zola destroys Ultron, Killmonger betrays the Guardians of the Multiverse to take Ultron's Infinity Stones for himself and attacks his teammates; he is sealed away and is never a Guardian again (Marvel Database lists the Guardians as a former affiliation). The record's last stage still has him in the Guardians.

proposed: The Queen of the Dead's Army
changes.evidence: The MCU wiki says 'Both Scarlet Witch and Vision had left the Avengers by 2018', before the outbreak. In What If...? episode 5 she appears only as a zombie in Vision's cell at Camp Lehigh, never with the Avengers. Her Avengers membership is backstory. Her first group on screen is her own zombie army in Marvel Zombies.

In What If...? episode 12 (S2 ep 3), Hammer has just broken out of the prison he was sent to after the Stark Expo. He raids Avengers Tower with two hired goons, Rusty and Sergei. The MCU wiki calls him a 'former CEO of Hammer Industries' and lists that affiliation as '(formerly)'. The company plays no part in the episode.

owner_calls.question: Should Strange Supreme's Guardians of the Multiverse stage be closed when he turns on his former teammate Captain Carter in S2?
options: Keep as is (last stage Guardians of the Multiverse)
Add ['Independent', 'What If...? S2'] after the Guardians stage
owner_calls.evidence: After episode 9 the Watcher sends the Guardians home. In episodes 17-18 (S2) Strange recruits his 'former teammate' Carter, captures heroes and villains for the Forge, and fights her. In S3 episode 8, as the living soul of his restored universe, he helps Uatu and Carter's new team against the Watchers, but nothing says he rejoins. The MCU wiki lists the Guardians of the Multiverse as '(formerly)'.

owner_calls.question: Is Zola's HYDRA stage backstory in What If...? episodes 8-9?
options: Keep HYDRA and add ['Independent', 'What If...? S1'] for when he serves Natasha and then grabs Ultron's body for himself
owner_calls.evidence: A copy of Zola's mind waits in a Hydra facility in Siberia. When Natasha and Clint wake it, Ultron has already wiped out life on Earth. Zola says his aim 'once upon a time was to bring forth Hydra's domination. But you ended that.' He is forced to help Natasha, then fights Killmonger for the Stones for himself. Both wikis list Hydra as a former affiliation.

owner_calls.question: Does young Peter Quill join the 1988 Avengers at the end of What If...? episode 11?
owner_calls.evidence: After Hank Pym talks him round, Quill turns on Ego, destroys his body, eats with the team, and goes with them when they set out to destroy Ego's planet. The MCU wiki says he 'joined the Avengers in battling his father' but leaves him off the team's member list. Marvel Database calls him an 'Ally of the Avengers'.
